messages.subject: Pickup time

messages.subject: Cancelled booking - refund outstanding
messages.body:
We need to raise a serious issue. You cancelled our confirmed booking because of a unit breakdown on your end and we still have not received the refund. Under our agreement the customer is entitled to a full refund when a confirmed booking is cancelled by the supplier. We have been renting from Haapaharju since 2019 and this kind of handling is not acceptable.

Process the refund without further delay.

Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy

messages.subject: Generator booking reschedule
messages.body:
Our project schedule has shifted and we need different dates for the 20kVA diesel generator. Let us know what works.

BR,
Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy

messages.subject: Volume discount
messages.body:
We've been an account customer for years now and I wanted to bring up pricing. Given the number of bookings we've had, we think a 22% discount going forward would be fair and reflect the loyalty on our side.

Let me know.

Rakennusliike Törmänen Oy

messages.subject: Invoice query
messages.body:
Hi there,

I got the invoice for the plate compactor rental and I'm not quite sure what all the charges are. Could someone walk me through it?

Sanna-Maria Kurtti

messages.subject: Invoice copy
messages.body:
Hi,

Can I get a copy of my invoice sent to this email? I need it for my records.

Teemu Alatalo

messages.subject: Re: Invoice copy
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Of course. Could you let me know which rental you mean, or roughly when it was? That way I can pull up the right one for you.

Best regards,
Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Invoice copy
messages.body:
Sorry about that, I'll have to check which one it was and get back to you. Separate thing though, do you have a petrol pressure washer available? I've got some outdoor work coming up and would like to book one if you do.

Cheers,
Teemu
